risk_flags: No logout/session-end step in either scenario — the Buy flow ends at Place Order with no explicit session termination captured.

The bearer token is captured once at Login and reused for both Add to Cart and Place Order; with hold-for set to 10 minutes, confirm the server-side token TTL so the load test doesn't fail mid-run on token expiry.

The 'keyword' field's only representation in the recording is the bare ${keyword} placeholder — unlike the other parametrization candidates there isn't even a single literal sample value to gauge realistic search terms from.

No CSV/data file is declared inside the YAML itself (csv_datasets is empty) — all five parametrization fields (keyword, email, password, sku, quantity) are referenced only as ${var} placeholders with no accompanying data source, so the test-data file has to be built from scratch rather than adapted from something already in the recording.

Two independent execution blocks/scenarios with different concurrency (browse: 100, buy: 20) represent two separate simulated populations, not one linear journey — a combined test needs to run both scenarios concurrently at roughly their recorded 5:1 ratio, not merge the steps into a single flow.

The recording is very short (2 steps in Browse, 3 in Buy) — no product detail page view, cart review, or shipping/payment step appears before Place Order. Confirm with the user whether this is the complete intended journey or a deliberately trimmed sample recording.

platform_guess is 'Generic' (no Magento/SFCC/Mirakl/Shopify signature detected in hosts or paths) — no platform-specific correlation conventions apply automatically; treat token/cartId handling as generic REST until confirmed otherwise.
